criterion: which news topic area the article covers

categories.name: Politics
categories.definition: Covers news about government, elections, political parties, public policy, and domestic legal or constitutional matters.

categories.name: Business
categories.definition: Covers news about economics, finance, companies, industries, markets, trade, employment, and corporate activities.

categories.name: Technology
categories.definition: Covers news about computing, internet, software, hardware, telecommunications, digital media, and technological innovation.

categories.name: Entertainment
categories.definition: Covers news about film, music, television, theatre, celebrity, awards, and festivals.

categories.name: Sport
categories.definition: Covers news about professional and amateur sports, including matches, results, player news, and club management.

categories.name: Social Issues
categories.definition: Covers news about societal concerns such as public health, education, poverty, human rights, demographics, and community affairs.

categories.name: International Relations
categories.definition: Covers news about diplomacy, foreign policy, international organizations, cross-border conflicts, and global cooperation.

categories.name: Environment
categories.definition: Covers news about climate change, pollution, conservation, environmental policy, and the impact of human activity on nature.

categories.name: Science
categories.definition: Covers news about scientific research, discoveries, academic studies, and scientific advancements.

categories.name: Culture
categories.definition: Covers news about arts (excluding mainstream entertainment), literature, heritage, and broader cultural trends.

categories.name: Disaster
categories.definition: Covers news about natural catastrophes and their immediate human and physical impact.

categories.name: Crime
categories.definition: Covers news about illegal activities, law enforcement, and judicial processes.
